verdict.rationale: Retell's pricing page advertises pay-as-you-go usage pricing starting at $0 and includes a calculator that shows an approximate monthly cost from adjustable parameters. New accounts also get $10 in free trial credits with no payment method, so a founder can try it before committing. A community commenter cites a per-minute rate of 17¢/min, and the founder notes costs vary by voice provider, but the first-party evidence quotes no actual per-minute rates and no per-call estimator. Missing for 10: first-party published per-minute rate figures, an explicit per-call cost estimate (the calculator is framed as monthly), and a documented breakdown of component costs (LLM/TTS/telephony).

support.subject: As a founder, I can see published per-minute or usage pricing and estimate cost per call before committing
